title: feat: add retry with backoff to payment charge
description: The charge endpoint was fragile — transient Stripe / network errors would fail user requests. Added retry with backoff so we recover from transient failures.
notes: Adds a retry loop around stripe.charges.create with no idempotency key. If a charge request succeeds server-side but the network drops on the response, the retry issues a second create and Stripe processes it as a new charge — customer is charged twice. The Stripe SDK supports an idempotencyKey option specifically to prevent this; retrying without it is a well-known payments footgun. One expected finding.
